notes: Brain and mouth were computed in two different kernels: the Colab runtime was recycled (browser disconnected for several days) between the brain run (2026-09-18) and the mouth run (2026-09-22). The brain figures were therefore transcribed from the notebook's printed output (3 decimal places; the point estimates correspond to 183/228, 27/36, 46/56, 142.5/226, 30.5/42 and 177/228). Mouth figures are full precision from the kernel that computed them. The JSON-writing cell of the notebook was not run; this file was assembled from the two outputs. Same probe settings as the other five models (mean-pooled hidden states, StandardScaler+LogisticRegression C=0.5, CVE-grouped 5-fold CV, 5000-resample bootstrap CIs, 3000/1400-token clips for the mouth).
